title: Density Bounds for the 3x+1 Problem I. Tree-Search Method

consultation.scope: Author manuscript dated 15 December 1993: introduction, Theorems 1.1-1.2 and Section 2 through Theorem 2.1; publication metadata checked against the author's bibliography.
consultation.remaining: Search computation not reproduced. The inspected Part I manuscript states exponent 0.65, while Part II's introduction cites 0.643 for its predecessor; do not conflate these versions.

notes: Finite-depth inverse trees are controlled by ternary residue classes, with parity weights used to obtain ancestor-count bounds. Direct prior art for the Collatz fibre and finite-residue counting programme. Cyclic roots can repeat vertex labels, so path counts and distinct ancestors must be separated. This source does not establish divergent reciprocal mass in a fate class or a Juggler transfer. See docs/research/literature_gap_recovery.md.
